newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL HOPING TO SIGN WEAH, SAYS SPANISH PRESS REPORT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL HOPING TO SIGN WEAH, SAYS SPANISH PRESS REPORT.

text.p: Real Madrid coach Fabio Capello is ready to buy striker George Weah from AC Milan, according to a report published by the Spanish sports daily "As".
The unsourced article says that Weah could replace Davor Suker, the Croatian forward who has attracted the attention of several English clubs since shooting to prominence in the Euro 96 tournament.
Capello recently signed defender Christian Panucci from his old club and is likely to be looking for more players released when the troubled Italian title-holders reshape their squad.
However, the Spanish transfer market does not reopen until the close season.
